periods.analysis: Navigation workshops drew 74 residents and health literacy sessions reached 220 children and adults. Adult weekday sessions were thinly attended, and the combined care listing began with a provider inventory.
periods.recommendations: Add evening workshops for shift workers and an evening option for adult literacy sessions.

periods.analysis: Workshop attendance rose to 118, and literacy completions reached 390 after we added an evening adult session at Riverside Library. A draft combined care listing is in provider review.
periods.recommendations: Launch the combined care listing and hold two evening workshops for shift workers at the Seaport Workers Clinic.

periods.analysis: Navigation workshops, age-tailored health literacy sessions and a combined care listing all progressed in Q3. Seaport Workers Clinic and Harborview Community Health Center are co-hosting the sessions that draw the most attendees. Spanish and Tagalog versions of the care listing are the main gap to close before year end.
periods.recommendations: Add Spanish and Tagalog care listings and train navigators for open enrollment.
